Description: Bulk capacitor on +5V for the amplifier’s peaks: 470 µF 10 V low-ESR electrolytic, 8 mm
Regulator input capacitor on +5V (U3): 22 µF ceramic, 10 V or more
Regulator output capacitor on +3V3 (U3), near the module’s 3V3 pin: 22 µF ceramic
+3V3 decoupling at the module’s 3V3 pin: 100 nF ceramic
EN power-on delay with R3 (holds the module in reset while +3V3 rises): 1 µF ceramic
Amplifier supply capacitor on +5V, at U4: 22 µF ceramic, 10 V or more
Amplifier VDD decoupling, right at U4’s VDD pins: 100 nF ceramic
Status LED, blue, 1206 (GPIO13 through R10)
Display header for a 1.3-inch SH1106 (or 0.96-inch SSD1306) 128x64 I2C OLED module: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA

Display header for a 1.54-inch ST7789 240x240 SPI TFT module: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA, RES, DC, CS, BL [https://oshwlab.com/scrators/st7789] [https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DN9NMBFW?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title]
USB-C power input, 5 V (power only, no data); fits on the front or the back
5 V DC barrel jack, centre positive (CUI PJ-102AH); regulated 5 V only
Speaker terminal: a 4 Ω, 3 W speaker (pin 1 SPK+, pin 2 SPK−)
Relay output: pin 2 is a 3.3 V logic signal for a relay module (GPIO12 through JP1), pin 1 GND
Programming header: GND, IO0, EN, TX, RX, 3V3 (a jumper on pins 1 and 2 at power-up starts download mode)
USB-C CC1 pull-down to GND: USB-C asks for 5.1 kΩ ±20 %, so 4.08 to 6.12 kΩ
USB-C CC2 pull-down to GND: USB-C asks for 5.1 kΩ ±20 %, so 4.08 to 6.12 kΩ
EN pull-up to +3V3 (4.7 to 10 kΩ); with C5 the power-on delay
GPIO0 pull-up to +3V3 (4.7 to 10 kΩ): high at reset is a normal boot
Amplifier SD_MODE from GPIO15 (4.7 to 10 kΩ): high plays the left channel
Optional, for 15 dB gain: fit it and cut JP2, with JP3’s centre bridged to the JP2 side
DISP_SDA pull-up to +3V3, for the OLED's I2C data (with a TFT the line carries SPI data)
DISP_SCL pull-up to +3V3, for the OLED's I2C clock (with a TFT the line carries the SPI clock)
Status LED resistor, 100 to 330 Ω: 100 Ω for blue, green and white LEDs (about 2.7 to 3 V), 300 to 330 Ω for red, orange and yellow (about 2 V)
Optional series resistor on the relay output (about 100 Ω): fit it and cut JP1
RF Module, ESP32-S3 SoC, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n, Bluetooth, BLE, 32-bit, 3.3V, onboard antenna, SMD
5-way switch, 10 x 10 mm through-hole, 4 directions and a centre push: Alps SKQUCAA010 or a copy (sold as 5-way switch 10*10*10 mm). Not SKQUAAA010, which has no centre push
1A Low Dropout regulator, positive, 3.3V fixed output, SOT-223: makes +3V3 from +5V
Mono I2S DAC and class-D amplifier, 3.2 W into 4 Ω, TQFN-16 (3 × 3 mm)
